news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.14 (vs ₹0.39 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.14 (up from ₹0.39 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹68.2m (up 60% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.36m (up ₹12.4m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.9% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 86% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 33% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹875.8m (US$9.71m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
